hook.name: QuoteAssetCreatorFeeHookV1
hook.description: Charges a fixed 1% fee on swaps in pools pairing a registered stock token against a supported quote asset, splitting 0.9% to the token creator's reward vault and 0.1% to a launcher fee recipient. Fees are collected via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta in the quote asset; pools must be registered by the token creator before use.
